module.purpose: Provides a development-only utility that recursively validates and freezes JavaScript objects to detect unintended mutations and unsupported prototype data.
module.summary: This module exports a generic helper for enforcing immutability during development. It first bypasses all work outside development mode, rejects objects with unsupported prototypes, preserves already frozen values, recursively freezes nested object properties, and finally freezes the input object itself. The validation permits arrays, ordinary objects, null-prototype objects, and structured-clone object prototypes while reporting unsupported data through both logging and an exception.
module.businessContext: Supports tldraw's development-time data integrity and immutability checks. If it fails, invalid record data or accidental mutations may escape detection during development.
functions: devFreeze (~L18-52): Recursively validates and freezes objects only during development

io: Logs an error to the console when an object has an unsupported prototype.
mutationOfArg: Recursively freezes nested object properties and then freezes the input object.

sectionMap.name: development guard
sectionMap.intent: Returns the original value without validation or mutation outside development mode.

sectionMap.name: prototype validation
sectionMap.intent: Rejects objects whose prototypes cannot represent supported record data.
sectionMap.predicate:
proto &&
		!(
			Array.isArray(object) ||
			proto === Object.prototype ||
			proto === null ||
			proto === STRUCTURED_CLONE_OBJECT_PROTOTYPE
		)

sectionMap.name: already frozen shortcut
sectionMap.intent: Avoids repeated traversal when the input object is already frozen.

sectionMap.name: property collection
sectionMap.intent: Collects all own property names before recursive freezing.

sectionMap.name: nested object traversal
sectionMap.intent: Recursively freezes each own property containing a truthy object value.

sectionMap.name: final freeze
sectionMap.intent: Freezes the validated object and returns the same object reference.

module.moduleLevelCode:
import { STRUCTURED_CLONE_OBJECT_PROTOTYPE } from '@tldraw/utils'
import { isDev } from './isDev'

units.name: devFreeze

detail.name: devFreeze
postconditions: In development mode, any supported object graph reachable through own properties is frozen unless the input was already frozen.
In development mode, an object with an unsupported non-null prototype is rejected before freezing.
invariants: The input object identity is preserved.
Nested object-valued own properties are processed before the containing object is frozen.
Already frozen values are returned without recursive processing.
edgeCases: When development mode is disabled, the input is returned immediately without prototype validation or freezing.
When the input is already frozen in development mode, it is returned unchanged.
Arrays, ordinary objects, null-prototype objects, and objects using STRUCTURED_CLONE_OBJECT_PROTOTYPE are eligible for recursive freezing.
An object with a non-null prototype other than Object.prototype, STRUCTURED_CLONE_OBJECT_PROTOTYPE, or an array prototype logs an error and throws.
Object-valued own properties are recursively processed; primitive-valued properties are not recursively processed.

errorPolicy.onInvalidInput: In development mode, objects with unsupported non-null prototypes cause an error to be logged and an Error to be thrown.

stateMutations: Freezes the input object and recursively reachable object-valued own properties in development mode.
detail.summary: Returns the supplied value unchanged outside development mode. In development mode, it recursively freezes supported object graphs and rejects objects containing non-JavaScript data prototypes.

specLiterals.value: cannot include non-js data in a record
specLiterals.role: Logged and thrown error message when an unsupported object prototype is encountered.

specTests.then: The exact same object reference is returned and the object remains unfrozen.
The exact same reference is returned and both the outer object and nested object are frozen.
console.error is called with "cannot include non-js data in a record" and an Error with that message is thrown.
